title: SkillOrderItem
description: Structured 3-tier skill resolution and fallback order for a portable pstack capability need.

need.description: The engineering task or intent (e.g. tdd, review, babysit, prove_it_works, debug_failure).

primary_pstack.description: First-tier pstack skill or playbook (e.g. /tdd, /interrogate, playbooks/babysit.md).

secondary_user.description: Second-tier user skill fallback when primary pstack skill is not loaded.

fallback_builtin.description: Third-tier host bundled or builtin fallback.

notes.description: Optional notes on gating, precedence, or conditions.
